field_key.f: published fWAR per side (bat: hitting group, pit: pitching group)
field_key.dh: headline eWAR minus fWAR per side, wins
field_key.dr: eWAR realized minus fWAR per side, wins
field_key.parts.abs: the ABS part per side: runs terms (move, cost on bat; charge, cost on pit), raw and re-centred, runs and wins
field_key.parts.xhem: the xHEM+ part on the hitting side, headline only: its re-centred runs, its wins at LAMBDA 0.5 and the arm the row took
field_key.dx: headline eWAR minus fWAR per side without the xHEM+ part, on a block that carries it (the eFV label's basis); a side not listed departs by 0

meta.what_this_is: eWAR v3: the frozen published fWAR vintage plus named departures, each zero-sum per season and side. The headline eWAR carries the ABS part (owner override EW3-32, 2026 on) and, provisionally, half of the xHEM+ batting part (2016 on, owner decision EW3-51); eWAR realized adds the realized pitching basis R2 (2016 on). A player-season not listed here carries fWAR unchanged on both series.

xhem.label: xHEM+ (expected batting, half weight)
xhem.how: owner decision EW3-51 (EBR_GATE.md 11.11), taken while the registered admission rule was not met: the skill look read the xHEM+ arm WIN (components) but its team guard NOT NON-INFERIOR (underpowered), and the holdout read UNRESOLVED; not a look
xhem.unit: runs (candidate part 4's re-centred d_batx), converted at the skill look's own runs per win, league_constants.league_totals(s)['rpw'], then halved
xhem.rows_rule: EBR_GATE.md 9.4 S1x as scored: the xHEM+ arm at 200 PA or more with a Savant xwOBA, the HEM+ arm's value on every other hitter-season, pitcher-batters 0
xhem.copy: Provisional. With its park effect counted once, xHEM+ improved next-season prediction over FanGraphs' batting in the 2021-2024 test (+0.045, range +0.028 to +0.060). A 2027 read decides whether it stays.
xhem.keep_or_remove: EWAR_XHEM_2027_READ, not before 2027-11-10 (EBR_GATE.md 11.11.5): KEEP if the gap's one-sided 95 percent lower bound is above 0 and the team guard is NON-INFERIOR; otherwise the flag goes False
xhem.label_basis: the eFV label reads the headline without this part (dx); its frozen vintage does not move (11.11.3)

park_match.construction: park-matched (EBR_GATE.md 11.12.2, owner decision EW3-52): d_pm = S1x's d_batx less b times fWAR's park term (FanGraphs' Basic (5yr) factor by B-Ref stint), b per arm the frozen share of that term the arm's rate re-introduces, re-centred per season
park_match.read: EBR_GATE.md 11.12.3 to 11.12.7; flipped only by an owner answer after a PASS

meta.fg_components: batting, baserunning, fielding and framing, the positional adjustment and pitching are FanGraphs' published components (no look-decided part is admitted); the headline series' batting also carries half of the xHEM+ part from 2016 (owner decision EW3-51, provisional)
meta.fielding_source: Its fielding is FanGraphs' published fielding and framing (Fld and Frm), the frame of this board.
meta.baserunning_source: Its baserunning is FanGraphs' published BsR, the column beside eBR here.

guard.how: identity: the ABS part, the only departure converted at RPW_s, carries no row on predictor seasons 2021 to 2024 (it begins in 2026); the xHEM+ part converts at the skill look's own runs per win whichever RPW_s is chosen (EBR_GATE.md 11.11.1), so the candidate's series equals the frame's on every row; dT is 0 under both bootstraps with sd 0; no WAR sum was related to a club outcome
